text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
(Even though McQueen warned me
about it, I was
still too focused on
Kita...)

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
I think I paid too much attention to
Dia...

text_block_list.name: Fan B
text_block_list.text:
Neither Satono Diamond or Kitasan
Black
claimed victory...

text_block_list.name: Fan A
text_block_list.text:
It'll be okay! The Kitasan we know and
love will
recover from this setback
through grit and
determination!

text_block_list.name: Fan C
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond's still got room to grow.
I doubt
she'll take this loss lying down!

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
It was a disappointing result, but both
Kita and
Dia are getting so much better!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
In which way do you mean exactly?
...Not that I
don't agree.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Watching them race kinda reminds me of
our own
duel.

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: You mean at the spring Tenno Sho?

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text:
Perhaps that will be their next race as
well.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: Maybe! By the way...

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text: I reeeaaally feel like running right now!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Oh? What a coincidence. So do I.

text_block_list.name: Tokai Teio
text_block_list.text:
Let's race back to the station on our way
home!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro McQueen
text_block_list.text: Yes. I'd like that.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...I doubt either one of us wants
things to
end
things this way.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You're right. We can't settle things
without a
perfect victory.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
The spring Tenno Sho! That's where I
want to race
you again!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
The spring Tenno Sho... So you're aiming
for a
consecutive win?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yep! At 3,200 meters, it's the longest
G1 race.
Let's kick off our next
showdown with a bang!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Talk to your Trainer and give it some
thought.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: I'll be waiting for you in Kyoto!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: So, Trainer... About my next race...

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Yes! ...But how did you know?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Satono Diamond said she wanted to
pursue
Kitasan Black while thinking
about what it means
to be illustrious.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
If Kitasan Black is her goal, it stands to
reason
that she'd want to enter the same
races.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
And knowing Satono Diamond, she'd
have extra motivation for the spring
Tenno Sho, a race where Kitasan Black
excels and is aiming for consecutive 
victories.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
You see right through me. Hm... If that's
the case,
it shouldn't be a problem if I
decide things on the
spot next time.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text: Hehe. I'm just kidding. ♪
choice_data_list: No, at least consult me first?!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
Today's defeat made me realize that I'm
not yet
strong enough to become an
illustrious runner.

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'll definitely come in first at the
spring
Tenno
Sho!

text_block_list.name: Satono Diamond
text_block_list.text:
I'd also like to bring the honor that goes
with it to
the Satono family.
